user.title: Connect VidaGrid (Growatt) Account
user.description: This portal's login requires a CAPTCHA, so paste in the Bearer token your browser already has after you sign in manually. {token_help}

data.site_id: Site ID (from the portal URL, e.g. site_detail/1224587)

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate VidaGrid
reauth_confirm.description: Your VidaGrid token expired (tokens typically last ~30 days). Sign into the portal again and paste a fresh Bearer token.

error.invalid_auth: Token was rejected. Make sure you copied the full value after 'Bearer ' with no extra spaces.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the VidaGrid portal. Check the base URL and your internet connection.
error.no_inverters: Enter at least one inverter serial number.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant logs for details.
